caption: The drawing consists of a grid-based quilt pattern composed of various geometric shapes, primarily triangles and rectangles, arranged in a larger rectangular frame. The central area of the composition is made up of several square blocks, each divided diagonally or vertically to form triangles or stripes, creating a patchwork effect. Three main color and pattern types are present: a peach-colored section with white floral patterns, a light cream section with small scattered black dots, and a black-and-white section with diagonal hatching lines. Some blocks feature vertical yellow stripes on a light background, and others show blue horizontal stripes. The outer edges have borders, with the top and left bordered with blue and white checks and lines, the bottom left with a red checkered pattern, and the right side with a yellow and red plaid pattern. The entire design is filled with repetitive geometric and floral motifs, with neatly drawn black outlines on a cream background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
